title: British Feet Grew Longer And Wider As Bodies Got Heavier
hook: Your feet can change shape long after you stop growing.
closing: Adult feet can lengthen and widen enough to change the shoe size you need.
question: Has your shoe size changed?

segments.say: Average British men's shoes reached size 10, showing feet grew longer across generations.
About 67 percent of women report wider adult feet, extending the change beyond length.
About 66 percent of adults in England carry excess weight, which can spread the foot.
